purpose: Metadata-only pilot; requires individual SHA-256 approval before execution.

queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n WHERE n.nspname = 'centrality' ORDER BY n.nspname LIMIT 250 OFFSET 0;

SELECT t.table_schema AS schema, t.table_name AS name, CASE WHEN t.table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 'view' ELSE 'table' END AS kind, '' AS description FROM information_schema.tables AS t WHERE t.table_schema = 'centrality' ORDER BY t.table_schema, t.table_name LIMIT 250 OFFSET 0;

SELECT c.table_schema AS schema, c.table_name AS relation, c.column_name AS name, c.data_type AS type, c.is_nullable = 'YES' AS nullable, '' AS description FROM information_schema.columns AS c WHERE c.table_schema = 'centrality' ORDER BY c.table_schema, c.table_name, c.ordinal_position LIMIT 250 OFFSET 0;

SELECT tc.table_schema AS schema, tc.table_name AS relation, tc.constraint_name AS name, kcu.column_name AS column_name, kcu.ordinal_position AS position FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu ON kcu.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema AND kcu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name WHERE tc.table_schema = 'centrality' AND tc.constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY' ORDER BY tc.table_schema, tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, kcu.ordinal_position LIMIT 250 OFFSET 0;

SELECT tc.table_schema AS schema, tc.table_name AS relation, tc.constraint_name AS name, kcu.column_name AS column_name, ccu.table_schema AS ref_schema, ccu.table_name AS ref_relation, ccu.column_name AS ref_column, kcu.ordinal_position AS position FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu ON kcu.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema AND kcu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu ON ccu.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema AND ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name WHERE tc.table_schema = 'centrality' AND tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY' ORDER BY tc.table_schema, tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, kcu.ordinal_position LIMIT 250 OFFSET 0;

SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS relation, i.relname AS name, ix.indisunique AS unique, a.attname AS column_name, x.ord AS position FROM pg_catalog.pg_index AS ix JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = ix.indrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN LATERAL unnest(ix.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(attnum, ord) ON true JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = x.attnum WHERE n.nspname = 'centrality' ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, i.relname, x.ord LIMIT 250 OFFSET 0;
